nightly-eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval (branch: main) — eval-suite 'prod_promptsets' shows spike in failure rate for model variant ptq-v2-prefetch (delta +6.4% vs baseline). details: https://internal.eval/reports/3524689000

maria_ml: seeing this now. which commit/rollout touched prefetch?

devon_infra: rolled runtime change yesterday 18:30 UTC that enabled KV prefetch heuristics by default for packed-kv models. commit 7c3a9f1. enabled_flag: runtime.kv_prefetch=true

sam_sre: canary graphs: ptq-v2-prefetch (canary group) EM drop ~2.3% on structured-output promptset, but higher on some FAQ prompts. latency unchanged.

emma_prod: these failing prompts include a lot of long context (avg seq_len ~1400). is prefetch interacting with KV stride or packed offsets?

lucas_research: log snippet from reproduce run (local, quant variant):
```
[2026-03-19T22:03:12Z] KVPrefetch: issuing prefetch for layer=18 start=0 len=2048 stride=64
[2026-03-19T22:03:12Z] PackedKV: read_offset adjusted -> 0x3f4
[2026-03-19T22:03:12Z] Dequantize: int8->fp16 path taken
[2026-03-19T22:03:12Z] Generation: early_stop triggered at token=118 (expected >150)
```

maria_ml: early_stop triggered looks suspicious. also note the Dequantize line — maybe a timing/ordering issue where prefetch overlaps with quant kernel conversion and evicts partial KV?

devon_infra: hypothesis: prefetch issues + packed-kv alignment + int8 dequant path can cause KV read races for long contexts -> truncated KV read -> model loses prefix and cuts generation. I can reproduce with a small harness.

sam_sre: priority: stop rollout, redo canary with prefetch disabled, and create gating rule for nightly (fail if structured-output EM drops >1.5% vs baseline).

emma_prod: agreed. also add a config check: for quantized variants (int8/ptq) with seq_len > 1024, runtime.kv_prefetch must be false by default.

lucas_research: quick repro commands I ran:
```
# reproduce locally
python eval/harness.py --model ptq-v2-prefetch --promptset structured-output --seq_len 1500 --runs 30 --disable-caching false
# patch to toggle prefetch
export REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FLAGS="runtime.kv_prefetch=false"
```

maria_ml: action items:
- devon to rollback canary and set runtime.kv_prefetch=false for the canary group (devon) :white_check_mark:
- devex/nightly to add gating rule (sam) :in_progress:
- research to produce minimal repro and PR with safety check in runtime (lucas) :in_progress:
- product to notify any active customers on Dedicated with manual prefetch enabled (emma) :todo

devon_infra: rolled canary rollback at 22:18 UTC (reverted 7c3a9f1 for canary pool). monitoring now.

sam_sre: updated nightly gating: added metric structured_output_em_delta with threshold -1.5% and auto-fail if exceeded. test scheduled for next run.

lucas_research: opened issue and WIP PR: runtime:guard-prefetch-for-quant (link: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/2048). patch enforces: if model.quantized==true and seq_len>1024 -> kv_prefetch=false and adds assert to avoid overlapping prefetch calls.

emma_prod: sending note to Dedicated customers with prefetch opt-in about potential degradation and that we are rolling back canary. cc: support.

maria_ml: followups: add unit test for packed-kv alignment + prefetch (lucas), add e2e nightly sub-suite to exercise long-context structured prompts (sam + devex), and re-run full eval after PR merge with canary disabled then re-enable under controlled canary with synthetic load.

sam_sre: timeline: rollback done, new gating in place for next run, PR review in progress. I'll own re-running the canary once PR merged.

maria_ml: thanks everyone — keep thread updated. we should do a short postmortem note in #postmortems once root cause is confirmed and fix shipped. :thumbsup:
